decisions.decision: Show same-member spring rows in Spread WinForms row outlines
decisions.rationale: The member-spring editor must use SheetView row outlines to fold adjacent rows of the same member. A compact sorted presentation preserves canonical source row IDs for calculation, persistence, row operations, and viewport selection. Collapsed summaries show full geometric length and masked spring values.
decisions.alternatives: GroupDataModel data grouping was implemented initially but was corrected by the user on 2026-10-01; Spread does not support combining that model with row outlines.
